Book the First--The Beginning


CHAPTER I

Alpha opens the tale with a paragraph of ordinary prose that gives the
paragraph splitter a real body to fold into one contiguous display unit.

CHAPTER II

Beta continues with a second chapter whose body is likewise a plain
paragraph of prose, so it is never mistaken for a heading or a divider.


Book the Second--The Middle


CHAPTER I

Gamma begins the second book with prose that stands on its own as the
body of the first chapter of the section, plainly and contiguously set.
